description: The classic platformer "?" block: a 16x16 block with a 1 px dark outline (k), riveted corners and a big question mark. normal = green (G g T) with a pale question mark (P); glow = the same, brighter with an orange (O) inner rim; used = an empty grey-brown spent block (e q n) without the question mark.

provenance.judgeReason: Variant 2 has the cleanest, most readable block: a bold off-white '?' with a tidy dark-green drop shadow, crisp corner rivets, and consistent upper-left lighting. Its hit frame adds a nice touch with the orange border and brass corner accents. Variant 1 is close but slightly less polished. Variant 3's black-outlined, grey-shaded '?' looks noisier, even though its brown used block reads well. All three used blocks share the odd brown edge.
